correction.content:
# Parcel handling fee
Status: Accepted
Owner: Billing Operations
Effective: 2026-11-12, supersedes decision 010 for handling fees.

Each unit in the quote represents one outbound parcel (not an item inside a parcel). Charge 175 cents for EACH unit: total handling_cents = 175 * units, not one flat fee for the quote. Examples: 0 units -> 0 cents, 1 -> 175, 2 -> 350, 17 -> 2975. Cancelled quotes always cost 0.
The units argument must be a nonnegative integer. Reject negatives and fractional values.
Do not change insurance rules. This revision replaces decision 010's earlier flat 250-cent-per-quote fee.
